summary: A quick two-player card game where players jointly build shared 'mandala' mountains of colored cards whose point values aren't fixed until later in the game, then race to claim the best-valued cards into their own river and cup. The tension comes from not knowing which colors will end up valuable until it's almost too late to react.
praised: clever hidden-value scoring twist that keeps both players guessing until late
tight, elegant two-player duel with a short playtime
high rules-to-depth ratio typical of the designers' other work
criticised: thin theme that feels attached after the fact
niche appeal mostly to fans of abstract two-player duels

interaction.kind: shared build with a common draw pool
interaction.detail: Both players play cards into two shared central mandalas that they build together, then take turns drawing from that common mountain into their own private river and cup. Choosing a color for yourself removes it from what the opponent can take, so the shared mandala functions as both a shared building space and a contested shared pool.

sources: Cards collected per color, valued by randomly revealed point tokens
scoring.how_you_win: Once all cards are distributed between the players' rivers and cups, each color's point value is revealed; whichever player holds the higher total value across their collected cards wins.
